items.prose: Twenty-five independent applications, each with an 8% chance of an offer.
items.question: What is the chance of no offer? Give three decimal places.

feedback.generic: Not quite right. Raise 0.92 to the 25th power.

byKey.comp: That is at least one offer.

explain.text: All twenty-five fail with chance $0.92^{25} \approx 0.1244$. As a check, $\ln 0.92 \approx -0.0834$, times 25 is $-2.085$, and $e^{-2.085} \approx 0.124$. Linked weaknesses would make it higher.

items.prose: Today is 2 November 2026. IMC's Amsterdam trader internship starts on 28 June 2027 (official posting, October 2026).
items.question: How many days away is the start?

feedback.generic: Not quite right. Count month by month.

explain.text: November has 28 days left. December to May add $31 + 31 + 28 + 31 + 30 + 31 = 182$. June adds 28, so 238. As a check, $238 = 7 \times 34$, and 2 November plus 34 weeks is 28 June.
